# Serapias × ambigua Rouy ex E.G.Camus

First published in J. Bot. (Morot) 6: 26 (1892)

This hybrid is accepted

The native range of this hybrid is Medit. It is a tuberous geophyte and grows primarily in the subtropical biome. The hybrid formula is S. cordigera × S. lingua.
